findings.ac: AC2: No references to deleted scripts in README, docs, or other scripts
findings.text: test_no_live_references_to_legacy_installers scans only LIVE_ROOTS (README.md, src, scripts, build, tests, .github, dist/skills) and omits docs/, so the AC's literal 'docs' is unasserted. docs/plans/stratos-4-1-followups-plan.md, lifecycle-run-defects-plan.md and host-agnostic-install-framework-plan.md still name install-claude-code / install-antigravity; no assertion would fail if a live docs page regressed to instruct running a deleted script.

findings.ac: AC3: tests/install-harness passes 100% without legacy installer paths
findings.text: No pytest asserts harness success. test_legacy_installers_retired.py only greps for the legacy names, and run-L1.sh/.ps1 are not exercised by any test in the diff (only the CI job install-harness-l1 in build-guard.yml and scripts/check.sh run run-L1.sh). L2 coverage was reduced: antigravity-global/local and claude-global prompts were deleted and run-L2.py now sys.exit()s for those scopes, with no test asserting the new exit path or the removed 'agent ran install script' check.

findings.ac: Slice path/mental model: harness validates marketplace and npx skills add paths
findings.text: The issue says the harness is updated to validate `npx skills add` and marketplace paths, but grep of tests/ finds no 'npx skills' assertion. The diff only deletes legacy cells and edits README wording; the retained marketplace-real.txt and claude-local.txt cover marketplace only, so the npx path is untested.
